_comment: ÐMP Collection Update — Metadata patch with supersedes chain
_doc: A collection-update appends a new record to the collection's update chain. It does NOT delete the original manifest — that remains on-chain permanently. The patch object contains only the fields being changed; all other fields retain their previous values. supersedes must point to the current chain head (the original manifest if this is the first update, or the previous update inscription ID).
_collection_id_note: The inscription ID of the original collection manifest — never changes across updates.
_supersedes_note: Must equal the current head of the update chain. For the first update, this equals collection_id. For subsequent updates, this equals the previous collection-update inscription ID. Indexers reject updates whose supersedes does not match the known head.
_update_of_note: Always equals collection_id. Redundant with collection_id but provided for indexer convenience — a single field always pointing at the root manifest.

patch._comment: Only include fields that are actually changing. Omitted fields retain their current values.
patch.description: 10,000 unique pixel art Doge characters — the original Dogecoin PFP collection. Now with verified rarity rankings.
patch._royalty_note: Reduced from 500 bps to 400 bps. Cannot exceed original value if supply_locked.

attributes_schema.name: RarityScore
attributes_schema._note: New attribute added — existing attributes not removed

_immutable_fields_note: The following fields cannot be in patch for any fixed collection: slug, type, supply (if supply_locked), creator_address (use key rotation procedure), chain.

_vote_proof_example._comment: This field is ONLY required when requires_vote: true is set on the original manifest. Omit entirely if requires_vote is false.

_indexer_checks: Verify collection_id references an existing collection manifest
Verify supersedes equals the current chain head for collection_id
Verify sig is valid for creator_address in the current manifest
Verify patch does not modify any immutable fields
If requires_vote is true on original manifest: verify vote_proof is present and valid
Apply patch fields on top of current manifest state to compute new state
Mark this inscription as the new chain head
